question: How much does replacing PVDF with PVDF latex and CMC raise the solids content of NMC 532 slurries, and by what share does the higher solids content cut the primary drying time of the graphite coating?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE id IN ('p8.L30','p8.L31','p8.L32','p8.L33','p8.L34','p8.L35') OR (page=8 AND text ILIKE '%drying time%') ORDER BY id

WITH t AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L34'), '(\d+)\s*$', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS a, CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L35'), 'to (\d+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS b, CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L32'), 'from (\d+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS c, CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L32'), 'to (\d+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS d) SELECT (a-b)/a AS drying_cut, (d-c)/c AS solids_rise, a, b FROM t
